CVE-2026-2604.title: Amazon Linux 2023 - ALAS2023-2026-1451: Medium priority package update for evolution-data-server
CVE-2026-2604.description: The Evolution backend server exposes the D-Bus service org.gnome.evolution.dataserver.AddressBook, that can be used in order to manage contacts. A Flatpak application with access to this D-Bus service can exploit this issue in order to gain arbitrary file deletion on the host filesystem.
